name: RA_CUSTOMER_PROFILES_INT_ALL
description: This is part of customer import program. This is the open interface table for the Customer profiles while importing customers

columns.name: INTERFACE_STATUS
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Interface status.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Unique batch identifier. Free text field.

columns.name: INSERT_UPDATE_FLAG
columns.description: Insert update indicator. Possible values: I, U. I means customer does not exist. Import customer information for the first time. U means customer exists. Specific customer information must be updated.

columns.name: VALIDATED_FLAG
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Validated indicator.

columns.name: CUST_ORIG_SYSTEM
columns.description: Original source system of customer data. Use Manage Source Systems task to identify valid values. Examples: Siebel, Dun and Bradstreet.

columns.name: CUST_ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.description: Uniquely identifies customer in original source system. Must be unique if INSERT_UPDATE_FLAG is I. Must be an existing value if INSERT_UPDATE_FLAG is U.

columns.name: CUST_SITE_ORIG_SYSTEM
columns.description: Original source system of customer site data. Use Manage Source Systems task to identify valid values. Examples: Siebel, Dun and Bradstreet.

columns.name: CUST_SITE_ORIG_SYS_REF
columns.description: Uniquely identifies customer site in original source system. Must be unique if INSERT_UPDATE_FLAG is I. Must be an existing value if INSERT_UPDATE_FLAG is U.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_PROFILE_CLASS_NAME
columns.description: Customer profile class. Use Manage Receivables Customer Profile Classes task to identify valid values.

columns.name: COLLECTOR_NAME
columns.description: Collector name. Use Manage Collectors task to identify valid values. Mandatory if CUSTOMER_PROFILE_CLASS_NAME is NULL.

columns.name: CREDIT_BALANCE_STATEMENTS
columns.description: Statement with credit balance can be sent to customer. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: CREDIT_CHECKING
columns.description: Credit check enabled for customer account. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: CREDIT_HOLD
columns.description: Customer on credit hold. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: DISCOUNT_TERMS
columns.description: Discount allowed. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: DUNNING_LETTERS
columns.description: Send dunning letter to customer account or site. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: INTEREST_CHARGES
columns.description: Late charges enabled indicator. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: STATEMENTS
columns.description: Create statements for customer account or site. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: TOLERANCE
columns.description: Credit limit over tolerance amount. Credit check tolerance amount over the credit limit. Must be between -100 and 100. Use comma for thousands separator. Use either comma or period as decimal separator.

columns.name: TAX_PRINTING_OPTION
columns.description: Indicates how to print tax information on invoices. Use Manage Receivables lookups, lookup type TAX_PRINTING_OPTION to identify valid values.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_STATUS
columns.description: Customer account status. Use Manage Receivables Lookups, lookup type ACCOUNT_STATUS to identify valid values.

columns.name: AUTOCASH_HIERARCHY_NAME
columns.description: Autocash rule set name. Use Manage Autocash Rule Sets task to identify valid values.

columns.name: CREDIT_RATING
columns.description: Customer credit rating. Use Manage Receivables lookups, lookup type CREDIT_RATING to identify valid values.

columns.name: DISCOUNT_GRACE_DAYS
columns.description: Discount grace days. Use comma for thousands separator. Whole numbers only.

columns.name: DUNNING_LETTER_SET_NAME
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: INTEREST_PERIOD_DAYS
columns.description: Number of days used in the interest period for calculating late charges. Use comma for thousands separator.  Whole numbers only.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_TERMS
columns.description: Override terms when creating invoices allowed. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: PAYMENT_GRACE_DAYS
columns.description: Payment grace days before interest may be charged. Use comma for thousands separator. Whole numbers only.

columns.name: PERCENT_COLLECTABLE
columns.description: Collectible percentage of customer balance. Must be between 0 and 100. Use comma for thousands separator. Use either comma or period as decimal separator.

columns.name: RISK_CODE
columns.description: Risk code.  Use Manage Receivables lookups, lookup type RISK_CODE to identify valid values.

columns.name: STANDARD_TERM_NAME
columns.description: Payment terms name. Use Manage Receivables Payment Terms task to identify valid values.

columns.name: STATEMENT_CYCLE_NAME
columns.description: Statement cycle name. Determines when to send statements to customers. Use Manage Statement Cycles task to identify valid values.

columns.name: CHARGE_ON_FINANCE_CHARGE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether to compound interest when calculating late charges. Possible values: Y, N.Mandatory if INTEREST_CHARGES is Y. Do not use if INTEREST_CHARGES is N or NULL.

columns.name: GROUPING_RULE_NAME
columns.description: Invoice line grouping rule name. Use Manage AutoInvoice Grouping Rules task to identify valid values.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code for profile amounts. Use Manage Currencies task to identify valid values. Use three character ISO code. Example: US Dollars is USD.

columns.name: AUTO_REC_MIN_RECEIPT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Minimum receipt amount for automatic receipts. Enter amount based on currency value from CURRENCY_CODE. Currency precision is enforced.  Must be greater than 0.

columns.name: INTEREST_RATE
columns.description: Interest calculation percentage rate. Enter as a percentage. Use comma for thousands separator. Use either comma or period as decimal separator.  Must be between 0 and 100.

columns.name: MAX_INTEREST_CHARGE
columns.description: Maximum interest charge. Enter amount based on currency value from CURRENCY_CODE. Use comma for thousands separator. Use either comma or period as decimal separator. Currency precision is enforced.  Must be greater than 0.

columns.name: MIN_DUNNING_AMOUNT
columns.description: Minimum amount past due for the customer account or site to send dunning letter. Enter amount based on currency value from CURRENCY_CODE. Use comma for thousands separator. Use either comma or period as decimal separator. Currency precision is enforced.  Must be greater than 0.

columns.name: MIN_DUNNING_INVOICE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Minimum amount on an invoice that is past due to send dunning letter. Enter amount based on currency value from CURRENCY_CODE. Use comma for thousands separator. Use either comma or period as decimal separator. Currency precision is enforced.  Must be greater than 0.

columns.name: MIN_FC_BALANCE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Minimum balance required for late charges calculation. Enter amount based on currency value from CURRENCY_CODE. Use comma for thousands separator. Use either comma or period as decimal separator. Currency precision is enforced.  Must be greater than 0.

columns.name: MIN_FC_INVOICE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Minimum invoice amount for late charges calculation. Enter amount based on currency value from CURRENCY_CODE. Use comma for thousands separator. Use either comma or period as decimal separator. Currency precision is enforced.  Must be greater than 0.

columns.name: MIN_STATEMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Minimum outstanding amount to generate statement. Use comma for thousands separator. Use either comma or period as decimal separator. Currency precision is enforced.  Must be greater than 0.

columns.name: OVERALL_CREDIT_LIMIT
columns.description: Customer account overall credit limit. Enter amount based on currency value from CURRENCY_CODE. Use comma for thousands separator. Use either comma or period as decimal separator. Currency precision is enforced.  Must be greater than 0.

columns.name: TRX_CREDIT_LIMIT
columns.description: Sales order credit limit. Enter amount based on currency value from CURRENCY_CODE. Use comma for thousands separator. Use either comma or period as decimal separator. Currency precision is enforced.  Must be greater than 0.

columns.name: LOCKBOX_MATCHING_OPTION
columns.description: Lockbox matching option. Use Manage Receivables Lookups task, lookup type ARLPLB_MATCHING_OPTION to identify valid values.

columns.name: AUTOCASH_HIERARCHY_NAME_ADR
columns.description: Autocash rule set name for remainder balance. Use Manage Autocash Rule Sets task to identify valid values.

columns.name: CREDIT_CLASSIFICATION
columns.description: Measure of customer credit worthiness. Use Manage Receivables Customer Profile Classes to identify valid values.

columns.name: CONS_BILL_LEVEL
columns.description: Balance forward bill level. Valid values: ACCOUNT, SITE. Required if CONS_INV_FLAG is Y.

columns.name: LATE_CHARGE_CALCULATION_TRX
columns.description: Late charges for overdue invoices and late payments. Use Manage Receivables Lookups task, lookup type AR_MANDATORY_LATE_CHARGES to identify valid values. Required if CONS_INV_FLAG is Y.

columns.name: CREDIT_ITEMS_FLAG
columns.description: Apply credit items to overdue balances and late charges. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: DISPUTED_TRANSACTIONS_FLAG
columns.description: Late charges for disputed items. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: LATE_CHARGE_TYPE
columns.description: Late charges calculation type. Use Manage Receivables Lookups, lookup type AR_LATE_CHARGE_TYPE to identify valid values.

columns.name: LATE_CHARGE_TERM_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Late charge transaction payment term identifier.

columns.name: INTEREST_CALCULATION_PERIOD
columns.description: Period used to calculate late charges. Use Manage Receivables Lookups, lookup type AR_CALCULATION_PERIOD to identify valid values.

columns.name: HOLD_CHARGED_INVOICES_FLAG
columns.description: Late charges can be calculated more than once. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: MESSAGE_TEXT_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: MULTIPLE_INTEREST_RATES_FLAG
columns.description: Interest and penalty charges can be calculated using multiple rates for a single late charge period. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: CHARGE_BEGIN_DATE
columns.description: Late charges start date. Date format: YYYY/MM/DD.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Conversion rate type. Use Manage Conversion Rate Types task to identify valid values.

columns.name: MIN_FC_INVOICE_OVERDUE_TYPE
columns.description: Minimum invoice balance overdue type. Use Manage Receivables Lookups task, lookup type AR_AMOUNT_PERCENT to identify valid values.

columns.name: MIN_FC_INVOICE_PERCENT
columns.description: Minimum invoice balance overdue percent. Use comma as thousands separator. Use either comma or period as decimal separator.  Must be between 0 and 100.

columns.name: MIN_FC_BALANCE_OVERDUE_TYPE
columns.description: Minimum customer balance overdue type. Use Manage Receivables Lookups task, lookup type AR_AMOUNT_PERCENT to identify valid values.

columns.name: MIN_FC_BALANCE_PERCENT
columns.description: Minimum customer balance overdue percent. Use comma as thousands separator. Use either comma or period as decimal separator.  Must be between 0 and 100.

columns.name: INTEREST_TYPE
columns.description: Interest charge type. Use Manage Receivables Lookups, lookup type AR_INTEREST_PENALTY_TYPE to identify valid values.

columns.name: INTEREST_FIXED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Interest charge amount. Use comma as thousands separator. Use either comma or period as decimal separator.  Must be greater than 0.

columns.name: INTEREST_SCHEDULE_ID
columns.description: Interest charge schedule identifier. Use Manage Charge Schedules task to identify valid values.

columns.name: PENALTY_TYPE
columns.description: Penalty calculation type. Use Manage Receivables Lookups, lookup type AR_INTEREST_PENALTY_TYPE to identify valid values.

columns.name: PENALTY_RATE
columns.description: Penalty rate. Use if FIXED_RATE is RATE. Must be between 0 and 100.

columns.name: MIN_INTEREST_CHARGE
columns.description: Minimum amount below which late charge must not be charged. Enter amount based on currency value from CURRENCY_CODE.  Must be greater than 0.

columns.name: PENALTY_FIXED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Penalty charge amount.  Must be greater than 0.

columns.name: PENALTY_SCHEDULE_ID
columns.description: Penalty charge schedule identifier. Use Manage Charge Schedules task to identify valid values.

columns.name: EXCEPTION_RULE_NAME
columns.description: Set of rules that determines how to manage remaining over and under application amounts after Lockbox processes receipts

columns.name: AUTOMATCH_RULE_NAME
columns.description: Set of rules that determines how receipts are matched automatically for the customer

columns.name: MATCH_BY_AUTOUPDATE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if AutoApply process can update the Match Receipt By value for the customer

columns.name: PREF_CONTACT_METHOD
columns.description: Preferred correspondence method for the customer interaction. Valid system predefined values are PRINT, EMAIL, and FAX. Default value is PRINT

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID for the Customer Import job that created the row.

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.description: This column is used by the import wizard to relate a record in the interface table to the file row.

columns.name: CREDIT_ANALYST_NAME
columns.description: Name of the credit analyst associated with this customer profile.

columns.name: CREDIT_REVIEW_CYCLE
columns.description: The period of a customer credit review cycle.  It is based on a list of values from the Lookup to user defined values in AR_LOOKUPS table.  Review Cycle must be predefined in the lookup type ORA_AR_CMGT_REVIEW_PERIOD.

columns.name: LAST_CREDIT_REVIEW_DATE
columns.description: Date of last customer profile data review.

columns.name: NEXT_CREDIT_REVIEW_DATE
columns.description: The next date that credit will be reviewed.

columns.name: B2B_TP_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the customer with a trading partner in a business-to-business relationship

columns.name: OFFSET_DAYS
columns.description: Number of days that used to calculate the expiration date of the authorization, default value is 5.

columns.name: PRINTING_OPTION_CODE
columns.description: Code that indicates if customer receives printed transactions.

columns.name: STMT_DELIVERY_METHOD
columns.description: Method of delivering statements to the customer. Valid values are E-Mail,PRINT and XML.

columns.name: TXN_DELIVERY_METHOD
columns.description: Method of delivering transactions to the customer. Valid values are PRINT and XML.

columns.name: XML_CB_FLAG
columns.description: Option to send chargebacks to customers in XML format.

columns.name: XML_CM_FLAG
columns.description: Option to send credit memos to customers in XML format.

columns.name: XML_DM_FLAG
columns.description: Option to send debit memos to customers in XML format.

columns.name: XML_INV_FLAG
columns.description: Option to send invoices to customers in XML format.

columns.name: SERVICE_PROVIDER_NAME
columns.description: Name of the B2B messaging service provider.

columns.name: PARTNER_ID
columns.description: User-defined code that identifies a customer account as a trading partner to receive XML transactions. You must also use the PARTNER_ID_TYPE_CODE attribute to indicate which category this identifier belongs to.

columns.name: PARTNER_ID_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Labeling category for the identifier that you used to define the trading partner in the PARTNER_ID attribute. Valid values are: DUNS, Generic (typically the customer account number), GLN, MISC, PHONE, TAXID, Name (typically the customer account name).

columns.name: AR_OUTBOUND_TRANSACTION_FLAG
columns.description: Option that indicates whether the trading partner is enabled to receive Receivables transactions in XML format.

columns.name: AR_INBOUND_CONFIRM_BOD_FLAG
columns.description: Option that indicates whether the trading partner is enabled to send back a confirmation business object document after receiving an XML transaction.

columns.name: CMK_CONFIG_FLAG
columns.description: Option that indicates whether the customer import includes the collaboration messaging configuration for the customer account.

columns.name: CMK_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Request ID generated by a run of the Import Collaboration Messaging Setup Data program invoked by the collaboration messaging framework.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_NUMBER
columns.description: Account Number

columns.name: PARTY_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique identification number for a party.

columns.name: AUTOCASH_TOLERANCE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Maximum amount in the business unit ledger currency to apply to the difference between the receipt amount and the open balance amount.

columns.name: EXCEPTION_ADJ_REASON_CODE
columns.description: Reason for adjustment activity against a transaction during a receipt application.Reasons are configued as lookup codes of the ADJUST_REASON lookup type.
